title: malus sylvestris var. aldenhamensis
intro: Malus sylvestris var. aldenhamensis, commonly known as Aldenham Crab Apple, is a variety of wild apple tree native to England. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Malus sylvestris var. aldenhamensis are thought to be due to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include malic acid, tartaric acid, and other organic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
